Cons.Name: Dreamweave
Cons.Effect: Upon entering the battlefield, Evelyn immediately gains 1,500 Decibels. Enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color> will be <color=#FFFFFF>Bound</color>. When Evelyn attacks <color=#FFFFFF>Bound</color> enemies, she ignores 12% of their DEF. When Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound</color> effect spreads to all enemies hit by the skill. This spread <color=#FFFFFF>Bound</color> effect lasts for 10s.

Cons.Name: Dance of Fire
Cons.Effect: Evelyn's ATK increases by 15%. When Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> consumed will be returned. This effect can trigger once every 25s. When Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, the skill's Interrupt Level increases.

Cons.Name: Fate's Melody
Cons.Effect: Upon activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Evelyn immediately gains a shield equal to 10% of her Max HP. While this shield exists, Evelyn's CRIT DMG increases by 40%.

Cons.Name: Bond of Light and Shadow
Cons.Effect: Upon launching a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Evelyn gains <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowstring Edge</color> for 20s. During <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowstring Edge</color>, when Evelyn hits her primary target with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, she additionally executes a <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> follow-up attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to 375% of her ATK to enemies in the area. This DMG is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> DMG and can trigger up to 16 times. Gaining another <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowstring Edge</color> will refresh the trigger count.
